description: This is a JUnit test class for the AdvancedPaymentAllocationsJsonParser in the Fineract project. It tests the parsing of JSON configurations related to advanced payment allocations for loan products, including various scenarios with valid, invalid, null, and empty inputs.

classes.name: AdvancedPaymentAllocationsJsonParserTest
classes.description: JUnit test class that verifies the proper parsing of payment allocation rules from JSON input strings, including handling of edge cases and validation logic.

methods.name: testEmptyJson
methods.description: Tests parsing with empty JSON, expects null result and validation call.

methods.name: testNullAllocationRuleJson
methods.description: Tests parsing when JSON does not contain allocation rules, expects null result and validation call.

methods.name: testParseSinglePaymentAllocation
methods.description: Tests parsing of a valid single payment allocation entry, checks correct parsing and validation interactions.

methods.name: testInvalidTransactionTypeAndFutureAllocation
methods.description: Tests handling of invalid transaction type and future installment allocation, expecting nulls where appropriate.

methods.name: testInvalidAndNullAllocationRules
methods.description: Verifies behavior when allocation rules contain invalid and null entries, expecting correct null handling.

methods.name: testNullTransactionTypeAndFutureAllocation
methods.description: Tests parsing when transaction type and future allocations are null, expecting full set of allocation types.

methods.name: createPaymentAllocationEntry
methods.description: Helper method to create mock JSON entries for payment allocations with specified attributes.

methods.name: createPaymentAllocationTypeList
methods.description: Creates a list of pairs mapping order integers to PaymentAllocationType enums for validation.

methods.name: createJsonCommand
methods.description: Converts a Map into a JsonCommand object by serializing it to JSON string and parsing it.
